chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muskan, from Hariz ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

He said to us: Perform salat al-Jumu'ah during travel in congregation without a khutbah, and recite aloud. So I said: Indeed, our reciting aloud in it during travel is disapproved of by others against us. He said: Recite aloud in it.

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the state in which the prayer ruling is being discussed
key_terms.الْجَهْرُ: audible recitation; raising the voice in reciting
key_terms.بِغَيْرِ خُطْبَةٍ: without a sermon; indicating omission of the khutbah in this case
key_terms.صَلَاةَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the Friday prayer being referred to in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Should the recitation be done aloud in salat al-Jumu'ah during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal instruction from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام regarding salat during travel. It states that salat al-Jumu'ah may be performed in congregation without a khutbah while traveling, and that the recitation in it should be done aloud despite objection from others.
